milestones.title: M12 — Historical Monitoring
milestones.objective: Add bounded local historical monitoring for device, service, and container operational trends.

workUnits.title: WU12-01 Historical metric domain and persistence
workUnits.objective: Add typed bounded historical records, migration, reload, and retention.

workUnits.title: WU12-02 Bounded historical sampling
workUnits.objective: Sample current monitoring snapshots without degrading current refreshes.
acceptanceCriteria: Partial data is absent rather than zero

workUnits.title: WU12-03 Historical query and downsampling API
workUnits.objective: Expose bounded typed history queries with deterministic aggregation.

workUnits.title: WU12-04 Historical monitoring UI
workUnits.objective: Render bounded historical trends in device, service, and container details.

workUnits.title: WU12-05 Integration and closure
workUnits.objective: Validate the integrated bounded historical monitoring milestone.
